title: gvylfs at price 6 on its four inner types b_f = -0.1, -0.03, +0.03, +0.1 (gvylfs6 without the +-0.2 types; the +0.2 solve hit the sweep cap)
question: Does type sign x leverage, with leverage entering only through equity's fixed coupon (as asset composition does in BGN and KP14), give a fair gap above 0.02?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-09). gvylfs6 with the +-0.2 types dropped: sol_gvylfs6f (+0.2, price 6) hit the 5600-sweep cap in a price cycle (qerr 8e-11, perr 2.1e-2) and failed the gate, while -0.2 and the four inner loadings converged. The four inner solves are reused unchanged (sol_gvylfs6i a..d are sol_gvylfs6b..e). Shares 0.25 each.

PREDICTION: the sign is hidden and leverage amplifies it, a product the linear model cannot hold; room and a gap. Whether the gap clears +0.02 depends on how much the coupon spreads equity's exposure; the endogenous-coupon version (gvy25s, gvy25sx2) had room 11-13% and no gap.

changes: drop the +-0.2 types (sol_gvylfs6a, sol_gvylfs6f); four types, shares 0.25; solves reused from gvylfs6

method.gs_capital_structure: gs_fixcs 2: firm-level coupon per unit capital drawn at birth uniformly from the grid nodes in [0.1, 0.9], fixed for life, no refinancing
